🇺🇸 Every flight in America was grounded for four hours... days after the FAA rolled its new AI traffic system out nationwide.

Retired Green Beret Anthony Aguilar sees three possible explanations: a glitch in that $875 million AI system, a cyberattack by China, North Korea or Russia, or a false flag meant to drag the US into striking Iran:

“What way, then, to get the United States to come in on this? Then to show something that said, look, look what Iran is doing.”

Officials blame overloaded routers and decades old copper lines and say there’s zero evidence of a cyberattack, so the real test is whether Washington checks the facts before anyone blames Tehran.
